A health researcher randomly selected $150$ people who regularly drink coffee. These individuals were asked whether they enjoyed the taste of a new herbal tea. Of those surveyed, $90%$ reported that they did not enjoy the tea. Which of the following conclusions is most justified based on this survey?

1. Most people who regularly drink coffee will not enjoy this herbal tea.
2. At least $90%$ of people who drink tea will not enjoy this herbal tea.
3. At least $90%$ of adults in general will not enjoy this herbal tea.
4. Most people who dislike coffee will enjoy this herbal tea.
